reasoning.rule: The Explorer classes every product of the chain with the stress-test rule. A stage needs allied action when it holds a product needing new capacity, managed reliance or coordinated trade. The lead mission's steps are ranked by the dollars of supply at risk, and the lead stage is where that mission's largest amount sits. Dollar ranking favours high-value downstream stages over small upstream chokepoints, so the chokepoint view is shown beside it.
